title: Finalize access-control flow and prepare production deployment

requirements.text: Update backend access-control initialization so that calls to `_initializeAccessControlWithSecret` from the frontend during authenticated actor creation never trap when the provided secret is empty/invalid, and do not prevent the actor from being created/usable for normal authenticated user actions (including `submitStory`).

quotes: I want the project to be finalised and published now

acceptanceCriteria: A user can authenticate via Internet Identity and the frontend can create an authenticated actor even when no `caffeineAdminToken` is provided.
After successful login without an admin token, `submitStory` can be called without an authorization trap.

requirements.text: Ensure any authenticated principal can obtain the `#user` permission required by user endpoints (at minimum `submitStory`, `addComment`, `addReview`, `getMySubmissions`, `getCallerUserProfile`, and `saveCallerUserProfile`) without requiring an admin token, using the existing initialization flow already invoked by the frontend.

quotes: I want the project to be finalised and published now

acceptanceCriteria: A newly authenticated principal (no admin token) can call `submitStory`, `addComment`, `addReview`, `getMySubmissions`, `getCallerUserProfile`, and `saveCallerUserProfile` without trapping for authorization.
Admin-only endpoints (e.g., moderation/publishing/delete) remain restricted and still trap/deny for non-admin users.

requirements.text: Keep `checkBackendHeartbeat()` callable without authentication and ensure it reliably returns `true` without trapping so frontend availability checks can consistently distinguish backend reachability from other failures.

quotes: I want the project to be finalised and published now

acceptanceCriteria: `checkBackendHeartbeat()` succeeds for anonymous callers and returns `true`.
`checkBackendHeartbeat()` does not trap under normal operation.

requirements.text: Perform final pre-release verification in the deployed environment to confirm the app is ready to publish/go live, including the end-to-end authenticated submission flow and key user interactions.

quotes: I want the project to be finalised and published now

acceptanceCriteria: Unauthenticated users can load the app, browse published stories, and the home/feed pages render without fatal errors.
A user can log in with Internet Identity, submit a story successfully, and then see it listed in “My Submissions” as pending.
A logged-in user can add a comment and a review to a published story without authorization errors.
Admin moderation workflows still require admin permissions and are not accidentally granted to normal users.
The app’s troubleshooting/availability check flow can successfully call the backend heartbeat and show backend reachability when the backend is up.

constraints: Backend must remain a single Motoko actor in backend/main.mo; do not introduce additional backend services.

Do not modify any files under frontend/src/hooks/useInternetIdentity.ts, frontend/src/hooks/useInternetIdentity.tsx, frontend/src/hooks/useActor.ts, frontend/src/main.tsx, or any sources under frontend/src/components/ui (compose instead).
Use English for any user-facing text.
nonGoals: Adding new product features beyond what is required to finalize and publish.
Major UI redesign or new visual theme work.
Integrations with third-party auth providers beyond Internet Identity.
